title: Context meter
description: How full the model's context window is: a small ring with the percent, token counts in a tooltip; amber from 80%, red from 95%.
when: Next to the composer or model picker in long chats and agent sessions.
a11y: role="meter" with aria-valuetext “12K / 200K token (6%)”; focusable so keyboard users get the tooltip; colour is backed by the percent.
